activity.overview: Listen to a short text about wind. Tell what wind is and what it can push.
activity.passage: Wind is air that moves. You cannot see the wind, but you can feel it on your face. You can see what it moves. A gentle wind makes leaves wiggle. A strong wind can bend tall trees. Wind pushes kites up high and pushes sailboats across the water.

questions.prompt: You cannot see the wind. How do you know it is there?
What can a strong wind do?
Draw something the wind is pushing.

activity.subject: science
activity.title: What Wind Can Do
